title: Application Administrator
description:
About OSF Digital:

OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner, we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.

We are seeking a dedicated Application Administrator to join our team. OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

Responsibilities:

  • Configuration of Email Studio, Journey Builder, and Automation Studio.
  • Creation and management of Data Streams, DMOs, and Segments in Data Cloud.
  • Integration with Salesforce Core, App/Site, and SFTP.
  • Support in data modeling, identity unification, and data-driven automations.
  • Troubleshooting and implementation of best practices in deliverability and governance.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in SFMC and Data Cloud.
  • Knowledge of SQL, Data Views, and integrations.

Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce Certifications (Email Specialist, Marketing Cloud Admin, or Data Cloud Consultant).
  • English or Spanish can be a bonus.

title: SAP PPDS Consultant
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced SAP PPDS Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PPDS/ePPDS) , preferably in an S/4HANA environment . This role involves working closely with business stakeholders to design, configure, and implement advanced planning solutions that optimize manufacturing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation and support of SAP PPDS solutions in S/4HANA environments.
  • Collaborate with business and IT teams to gather requirements and provide the best SAP-based planning and scheduling solutions.
  • Configure PPDS functionalities such as heuristic-based planning, optimizer-based planning, block planning, and capacity leveling.
  • Optimize master data such as resource capacities, production versions, PDS (Production Data Structures), and PPMs (Production Process Models) .
  • Integrate PPDS with other SAP modules like PP, MM, SD, and EWM for seamless production planning.
  • Provide expertise in Order-based and Time-continuous Scheduling , pegging strategies, and alert monitoring.
  • Support CIF (Core Interface) integration between SAP ERP and PPDS.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring smooth business operations.
  • Conduct user training and create documentation for system configurations and processes.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in SAP PPDS implementation and support.
  • Strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA PPDS , including DS Board, PPDS Optimizer, Planning Procedures, and Interactive Planning .
  • Experience in CIF integration between SAP ECC/S4HANA and PPDS.
  • Solid understanding of production planning processes , including Make-to-Order (MTO), Make-to-Stock (MTS), and Repetitive Manufacturing .
  • Hands-on experience in heuristics, capacity leveling, and scheduling strategies .
  • Strong knowledge of SAP PP/MM and integration with EWM .
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP PPDS certification .
  • Experience with Industry-specific solutions such as Automotive, Consumer Goods, or Manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning) and APO (Advanced Planning & Optimization).

title: Desenvolvedor Devops Backend Sênior
description:
Procuramos uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora DevOps Back-End Sênior com perfil altamente técnico e foco em desenvolvimento back-end com Node.js, ambientes em nuvem AWS, automação de infraestrutura com Terraform, uso avançado de Docker e criação de pipelines CI/CD robustas. Essa pessoa será essencial para garantir escalabilidade, segurança, performance e integração fluida entre desenvolvimento e operações em ambientes altamente distribuídos.


Mais do que contratar pessoas, queremos gerar oportunidades para todos, garantindo a inclusão de perfis cada vez mais diversos para somar com NOSSA GENTE! Se você também pensa assim, que tal fazer parte desse time?


Descrição da vaga:

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end escaláveis e performáticas utilizando Node.js e TypeScript.

- Projetar, automatizar e manter pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD), garantindo deploys seguros e consistentes.

- Automatizar o provisionamento de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform.

- Criar e gerenciar ambientes Docker, garantindo boas práticas em containerização.

- Gerenciar e monitorar ambientes em AWS, com domínio sobre serviços como Lambda, S3, API Gateway, EC2, SQS, RDS, DynamoDB e Amplify.

- Colaborar com as equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e infraestrutura para garantir soluções escaláveis e seguras.

- Garantir qualidade e rastreabilidade com testes automatizados, controle de versão e revisão de código.

- Atuar na observabilidade do ambiente, implementando práticas de monitoramento, métricas e logs.



Requisitos Obrigatórios:

- Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento Node.js e TypeScript, com foco em back-end.

- Domínio em AWS, com conhecimento avançado em seus principais serviços.

- Vivência na criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD, utilizando ferramentas como GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou similares.

- Experiência prática com Terraform para automação da infraestrutura como código (IaC).

- Proficiência com Docker e containerização de aplicações.

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e versionamento com Git.

- Mentalidade DevOps, com foco em entrega contínua, automação e melhoria contínua.



Diferenciais (não obrigatórios):

- Conhecimento em orquestração de containers com Kubernetes.

- Certificações AWS ou DevOps.

- Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (ex.: ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).

- Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança (DevSecOps).

- Experiência em ambientes com microserviços.

Mais do que contratar pessoas, queremos gerar oportunidades para todos, garantindo a inclusão de perfis cada vez mais diversos para somar com NOSSA GENTE! Se você também pensa assim, que tal fazer parte desse time?

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end escaláveis e performáticas utilizando Node.js e TypeScript.

- Projetar, automatizar e manter pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD), garantindo deploys seguros e consistentes.

- Automatizar o provisionamento de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform.

- Criar e gerenciar ambientes Docker, garantindo boas práticas em containerização.

- Gerenciar e monitorar ambientes em AWS, com domínio sobre serviços como Lambda, S3, API Gateway, EC2, SQS, RDS, DynamoDB e Amplify.

- Atuar na observabilidade do ambiente, implementando práticas de monitoramento, métricas e logs.

- Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento Node.js e TypeScript, com foco em back-end.

- Domínio em AWS, com conhecimento avançado em seus principais serviços.

- Vivência na criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD, utilizando ferramentas como GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou similares.

- Experiência em ambientes com microserviços.

title: Lider Tecnico de Sustentação (FullStack)
description:
A Keyrus acredita na diversidade e na inclusão. Encorajamos a todos a participarem em nosso processo de contratação, não importando o gênero, idade, raça, religião. Não permitimos nenhum tipo de discriminação. Isto é reforçado no processo de contratação e vivido dessa forma na empresa.

Sabemos que grandes resultados só são alcançados com uma grande equipe, por isso procuramos pessoas talentosas e apaixonadas, com desejo de crescer profissionalmente e criar uma trajetória de carreira conosco.

Estamos em busca de um Líder Técnico de Sustentação (FullStack) para integrar nossa equipe. Esse profissional será responsável por liderar tecnicamente as operações, gerenciar prioridades técnicas, garantir a eficiência das entregas, identificar e mitigar riscos, além de atuar como um ponto de conexão entre diferentes áreas da empresa.

O candidato ideal deve ter um sólido background técnico, habilidades de liderança e capacidade para conduzir análises, investigar e resolver incidentes em ambientes de produção. Além disso, será essencial implementar melhorias nos processos e garantir a adequada transição de conhecimento de sistemas em publicação.

Papéis e Responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente as atividades e gerenciar prioridades técnicas. Garantir a eficiência e qualidade das entregas técnicas.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos operacionais.
  • Investigar e resolver requisições de serviço e incidentes em ambientes de produção, em colaboração com times operacionais e ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Idealizar, conduzir e implementar melhorias e evoluções nos processos existentes.
  • Realizar transições de sistemas em fase de publicação junto aos times de desenvolvimento, absorvendo o conhecimento necessário para suporte em produção.
  • Avaliar e garantir que as soluções de monitoramento sejam adequadas para os sistemas em produção, incluindo novos sistemas.

Qualificações Essenciais

Horário de Trabalho:

  • Jornada no Horário da Europa Central (CET):
  • 05:00 - 14:00 (BRT) / 09:00 - 18:00 (CET).

Idiomas

  • Inglês avançado/fluente.

Requisitos Técnicos

Nuvem Pública (principalmente Azure):

  • Funcionamento básico e principais serviços (AKS, WebApp, Functions, ServiceBus, EventHub, SQL Database, CDN).
  • Análise de métricas de utilização/saturação e logs.
  • Interação entre serviços.

Banco De Dados

  • Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Redis.
  • MongoDB.

Backend

  • Java 11+.
  • Spring Boot.
  • Kubernetes.
  • EventHub/Kafka/RabbitMQ/ServiceBus.

Frontend

  • ReactJS.
  • JavaScript.
  • HTML.
  • CSS.

Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com práticas DevOps.
  • Conhecimento em Terraform/ARM.
  • Experiência com sistemas Unix/Linux.

title: Java and Angular Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are you going to do?

  • Over 4 years of experience as a Software Engineer;
  • Strong knowledge of Java, Angular, and Kafka;
  • Good level of English, at least B2 (Mandatory);
  • Willingness to move to Portugal (Mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you at


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for one year period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Analista de Engenharia Pleno - Segurança Hídrica
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar na análise e desenvolvimento de estudos hidrológicos voltados à mitigação dos impactos de estiagens e secas;
  • Realizar o levantamento e monitoramento de indicadores de vazão, precipitação, volume de chuvas e comportamento de rios e barragens;
  • Avaliar e propor fontes alternativas de abastecimento, contribuindo para a elaboração de soluções técnicas e planos de investimento de capital (CAPEX);
  • Monitorar eventos climáticos e hidrológicos, analisando seus impactos sobre as operações da companhia e apoiando a tomada de decisão técnica;
  • Integrar e consolidar informações provenientes de dados de sensoriamento remoto, estudos climáticos, bases meteorológicas e análises de mercado especializadas, como as do Climatempo;
  • Manter comunicação ativa e constante com as frentes operacionais e áreas técnicas, garantindo agilidade e precisão nas ações preventivas e corretivas;
  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico voltado à segurança hídrica, considerando cenários de estiagem, baixa vazão de rios e mudanças climáticas;
  • Garantir o registro e atualização de dados técnicos, assegurando rastreabilidade e consistência das informações analisadas.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Ambiental, Sanitária, Hídrica, Civil;
  • Experiência ou estudos na área de recursos hídricos, hidrologia e segurança hídrica;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de geoprocessamento, incluindo ArcGIS e QGIS;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise e tratamento de dados, como Microsoft Excel e Power BI;
  • Residir em Belém/PA ou região;
  • Disponibilidade total para viagens nas regiões Norte e Nordeste do país.


Desejável:

  • Desejável formação de pós-graduação ou mestrado na área de recursos hídricos, hidrologia ou engenharia ambiental.


Informações adicionais:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

title: Engenharia de confiabilidade de sites (SRE)
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que buscamos?


Engenharia de confiabilidade de sites (SRE)


Requisitos:


  • Engenharia e otimização de ambientes Linux/Openstack;
  • Análise de performance e hardening;

  • Observability & monitoring : Prometheus , Grafana e ELK;

title: AEM Architect
description:
Company: Insight Global Services Team, supporting Global Manufacturing Client

Type: Long term PJ Contract

Location: Remote in Brazil

Interview Process: 1 round technical interview


Requirements:

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise-level software development and architecture.
  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience with Adobe AEM.
  • Demonstrated success in leading large-scale AEM implementations and integrations.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


Nice to Have:

  • Adobe Certified Expert in AEM Sites Architect or similar certification.
  • Experience working in global delivery models and distributed teams.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).


We are seeking an experienced Adobe AEM Architect with a proven track record of designing and implementing scalable, enterprise-level solutions. This role requires deep technical expertise in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), strong leadership skills, and the ability to collaborate across multiple teams to deliver integrated digital experiences. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AEM architecture, commerce integrations, and Adobe Experience Cloud products, combined with advanced knowledge of modern web technologies and Agile methodologies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architectural Leadership:
  • Lead the design and architecture of AEM-based solutions, including CRX/CRXDE, WCM, DAM, Launch, and Analytics.
  • Define best practices for AEM implementation and ensure adherence to architectural standards.
  • Solution Delivery:
  • Implement scalable AEM solutions for web and mobile platforms.
  • Oversee Adobe development efforts and provide technical guidance to development teams.
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements and deliver effective, sustainable solutions.
  • Integration & Innovation:
  • Evaluate emerging digital technologies for fit and sustainability within the enterprise ecosystem.
  • Integrate AEM with e-commerce platforms (ATG, Magento, etc.) and payment gateway systems.
  • Implement Adobe Experience Cloud products such as Target, Launch, and Analytics for personalization and optimization.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Work with product managers, designers, and engineering teams to deliver integrated digital experiences.
  • Drive Agile principles and practices to manage and deliver projects effectively.

The ideal candidate will use their passion for big data and analytics to provide insights to the business covering a range of topics. They will be responsible for conducting both recurring and ad hoc analysis for business users. 

Responsibilities
  • Understand the day-to-day issues that our business faces, which can be better understood with data
  • Compile and analyze data related to business' issues
  • Develop clear visualizations to convey complicated data in a straightforward fashion


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics or Applied Mathematics or equivalent experience
  • 1 - 2 years' Data Analysis experience
  • Proficient in SQL

title: Tech Recruiter Senior
description:
Estamos em busca de Tech Recruiter Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL.


Você será responsável por:


  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento de tecnologia de ponta a ponta ;
  • Realizar hunting ativo e geração de pipeline qualificado;
  • Conduzir entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais de forma estruturada, garantindo aderência cultural e técnica;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com líderes e stakeholders, atuando de forma consultiva;
  • Alimentar e gerenciar informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter , garantindo a qualidade dos dados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e propor melhorias nos processos de recrutamento.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência prévia como Tech Recruiter em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Domínio de LinkedIn Recruiter e ferramentas de sourcing (boolean search, AI tools, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em perfis técnicos (Desenvolvedores, QA, DevOps, Data, Machine Learning, etc.);
  • Experiência com métricas de recrutamento (taxa de conversão, tempo de fechamento);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa , em ambiente remoto e dinâmico.
  • Habilidades de negociação, comunicação e resiliência.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer.

Innovecs is a global digital services company with a presence in the US, the UK, the EU, Israel, Australia, and Ukraine. Specializing in software solutions, the Innovecs team has experience in Supply Chain, Healthtech, Collaboration Tech, and Gaming.


For the fifth year in a row, Innovecs is included in the Inc. 5000, the list of fastest-growing private companies in the US, and a ranking of the best global outsourcing service providers by IAOP. Recently, Innovecs was honored with the prestigious Global Good Awards for the Employee Engagement & Wellbeing, won gold at the Employer Brand Management Awards, and was included in the Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces Ranking.



Our value to you:

  • Flexible hours and remote-first mode,
  • Competitive compensation,
  • Complete Hardware/Software setup – anything you need for work,
  • Open-door culture, transparent communication, and top management at a handshake distance,
  • Health insurance, vacation, sick leaves, holidays, paid maternity/paternity leave,
  • Access to our learning & development center: workshops, webinars, training platform, and edutainment events,
  • Virtual team buildings and social activities.


Requirements:

Education & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps roles with deep, hands-on experience across both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS),
  • Expertise in CI/CD pipeline development and automation using GitLab Ultimate,
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS & EKS),
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), primarily using Terraform,
  • Experience in monitoring, performance optimization, and system security,
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Advanced Cloud Security: Experience with cloud-native security tools, identity management, and implementing security best practices,
  • MLOps Experience: Exposure to building or managing infrastructure for machine learning pipelines (e.g., Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker, MLFlow, KubeFlow).


Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure across Azure and AWS,
  • Develop and automate CI/CD pipelines for application deployment using GitLab Ultimate,
  • Manage and optimize containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS),
  • Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code, primarily using Terraform,
  • Monitor system performance, ensure high availability, and proactively address issues,
  • Apply cloud security best practices, including identity management and threat detection,
  • Continuously evaluate and integrate new tools and technologies to improve DevOps processes.

  • MLOps Experience: Exposure to building or managing infrastructure for machine learning pipelines (e.g., Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker, MLFlow, KubeFlow).


Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure across Azure and AWS,
  • Develop and automate CI/CD pipelines for application deployment using GitLab Ultimate,
  • Manage and optimize containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS),
  • Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code, primarily using Terraform,
  • Monitor system performance, ensure high availability, and proactively address issues,
  • Apply cloud security best practices, including identity management and threat detection,
  • Continuously evaluate and integrate new tools and technologies to improve DevOps processes.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Especialista em Parcerias Estratégicas
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Especialista em Parcerias para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Identificar, mapear e prospectar organizações estratégicas (empresas de grande porte, associações e sindicatos).
  • Estruturar e negociar parcerias comerciais com potencial de gerar grande volume de usuários ou receita recorrente.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com BPOs que atendem empresas de grande porte para viabilizar contratos de alto impacto.
  • Representar a Jusfy em eventos estratégicos do setor jurídico, contábil e corporativo.
  • Acompanhar performance das parcerias e propor planos de expansão.


Experiência

  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas, negócios corporativos ou vendas complexas (preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia).
  • Vivência em ambiente de crescimento e ritmo acelerado.
  • Disponibilidade para visitas presenciais a clientes/parceiros.


Diferencial

  • Experiência ou conhecimentos sobre o mercado jurídico.


Habilidades

  • Capacidade de negociação em alto nível e construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de representação em eventos externos.


Ferramentas e dados

  • Experiência com CRM (preferencialmente Hubspot)


Perfil comportamental

  • Proatividade, ownership e foco em solução de problemas
  • Curiosidade e sede por aprendizado contínuo
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultados e crescimento


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Infra/Deploy)
description:
About the Project

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role:

As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Solutions team spans the globe and uses the SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing.

Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program. We are employing best-in-breed tools along with processes co-authored or directly influenced by our team. We believe in the power of great customer experience, and the happiest customers are made by having the happiest team helping them.


Work Hours : PST business hours.


Required skills:

  • Proven hands-on experience supporting a software platform/product in a customer-facing B2B environment.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux operating systems (Debian and RHEL-based), including package management, service management, log analysis, file permissions, user and process management, and troubleshooting system resources (CPU, memory, disk, I/O).
  • Basic networking knowledge, including OSI,DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, subnets, routing, and firewall concepts, with ability to troubleshoot using tools like ping, traceroute, curl, or netstat.
  • Understanding of containerisation (images, containers, networking, volumes) and virtualisation (VMs, hypervisors) concepts, and familiarity with orchestration concepts such as deployments, scaling, and service discovery.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a strong advantage.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Python or scripting languages such as Bash is a plus.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs is an advantage.
  • Experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is an advantage.


About you:

  • You have a data-driven, analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills
  • You are detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines
  • You demonstrate a proven ability to stay motivated and work effectively both independently and as part of a team
  • You bring a proactive passion for supporting and helping others
  • You have a strong desire to learn, grow, and contribute to the company’s core values of collaboration and service
  • You possess excellent English communication, listening, and writing skills
  • You possess a strong sense towards customer sentiment and adapt your communication style accordingly
  • You are clear in setting expectations and meeting the promised timeline


Scope of work:

  • You will handle customer questions and issues by combining business acumen with technical assessment skills. You will perform troubleshooting of issues both through the UI and the terminal
  • You will work closely with Senior team members to develop your skills and technical expertise within specific areas of the product, with ongoing opportunities to grow
  • You will partner with Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Product to recognize trends in customer feedback and translate customer needs into a better overall product

title: Amazon Account Manager
description:
Type: Full-Time Remote (must have video call on during the entire shift)

Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST 


About Elumacom

Elumacom is a dynamic eCommerce business founded in 2016 and headquartered in Montreal, Canada. We sell on multiple online channels and partner with retail brands to expand their presence into eCommerce. Our team includes local office staff, a dedicated warehouse crew, and an expanding overseas support network. At Elumacom, we value a motivated, friendly, and respectful work environment where collaboration and positive interactions drive our success.


Role Overview

We are seeking a responsible, proactive, and energetic Amazon Account Manager to oversee and optimize our Amazon Seller Central operations. This remote position is open to overseas candidates, but you must be fluent in English (spoken and written) with strong communication skills.


Responsibilities

  • Manage daily Amazon Seller Central tasks: account emails, buyer messages, suppressed listings, tickets, and account health.
  • Track sales, returns, and profitability; prepare accurate weekly and monthly reports using advanced Excel formulas (PivotTables, VLOOKUP, etc.).
  • Monitor competitor pricing, Buy Box performance, PPC spend, and customer feedback.
  • Investigate issues independently, provide solutions, and take ownership until resolved.
  • Collaborate with local team members via full-time video presence during work hours .


Requirements

  • Fluent in written and spoken English.
  • Proven experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.
  • Advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, VLOOKUP, formulas, reporting).
  • Strong problem-solving and investigative abilities; willing to go the extra mile.
  • Highly responsible, able to take initiative and ownership.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and capable PC.
  • Positive, proactive, and team-oriented attitude.


Why Join Us?

At Elumacom, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to a growing company, and be part of a collaborative, international team. We are dedicated to supporting our employees with the tools, trust, and opportunities they need to succeed.



How to Apply: Send your resume and a brief cover letter to with the subject line Amazon Account Manager Application.

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

title: Interface Designer / Web Developer
description:
Location: The role is fully remote. However, given our team’s current setup and time-zone alignment, we have a preference for candidates based in Europe, Latin America, or Mexico. 

Who We Are


COMO DL S.A., operating under the brand 'COMO Digital Life', is a regulated payment institution in Luxembourg. As a SWIFT member, COMO DL offers SEPA and SWIFT payments and issues multi-currency LU IBANs.  


COMO Digital Life is revolutionizing corporate banking and treasury management with a next-generation, fully digitalized financial platform. Headquartered in Luxembourg COMO blends advanced cloud-native technology, rigorous compliance, and a user-first approach to set a new global standard in financial services. 


We believe great companies are built on clarity, care, and collaboration. If you’re ambitious, love creating new opportunities, and want to grow your career in a dynamic international environment, this is the place for you. 

Role Overview  


As a full-time remote Interface Designer / Web Developer at COMO, you will be responsible for building, deploying, and optimizing user-centric digital interfaces across COMO’s platforms. You will play a pivotal role in translating design concepts into functional, responsive, and accessible web experiences that embody COMO’s brand identity and meet the highest standards of usability and performance. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you will ensure that all digital touchpoints are engaging, reliable, and aligned with the company’s vision. 


Key Responsibilities  


  • Deployment & Implementation: Develop, configure, and maintain website pages on platforms such as WixStudio, Webflow, and MS Azure. Ensure seamless integration of pre-designed screens while optimizing for performance, security, and scalability. Guarantee cross-browser compatibility, consistent branding, and operational excellence across devices. 
  • User Experience Development: Design and refine intuitive user journeys that address client and partner needs. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business and user requirements into impactful digital solutions. 
  • User Interface Engineering: Transform design assets into interactive, user-friendly interfaces. Apply best practices in layout, typography, color, and accessibility to deliver interfaces that are both visually appealing and functional. 
  • Wireframing & Prototyping: Create and iterate on wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to test concepts, gather stakeholder feedback, and enhance usability before full-scale implementation. 
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough reviews, testing, and debugging of deployed solutions. Ensure compliance with brand guidelines, technical specifications, and accessibility standards, delivering polished and reliable outcomes. 
  • Design System Integration: Contribute to the development and maintenance of COMO’s design system. Ensure components and patterns are consistently applied to achieve scalability and alignment across digital products. 
  • Responsive & Adaptive Design: Implement designs that adapt fluidly to various devices and screen sizes, ensuring seamless user experiences on desktop, tablet, and mobile. 
  • Accessibility Compliance: Apply WCAG and other accessibility standards to guarantee inclusive digital products. Perform accessibility audits and implement improvements as required. 
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work in partnership with designers, marketers, and developers to deliver projects on time and to the highest quality. Communicate technical approaches clearly, aligning design and development decisions with business goals. 
  • Continuous Learning & Innovation: Keep pace with evolving platforms, frameworks, and industry best practices. Experiment with new tools and methods to enhance COMO’s web platforms and bring forward innovative digital experiences. 


Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Web Development, Computer Science, or related field. 
  • Minimum 3-5 years of professional experience in web development, ideally within a corporate or B2B environment. 
  • Demonstrated expertise in multiple modern web development platforms (e.g., WixStudio, Webflow, MS Azure) as well as strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive frameworks. 
  • Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, accessibility standards, and cross-browser compatibility. 
  • Experience with prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD) and design-to-code workflows. 
  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development practices. 
  • Knowledge of financial services or banking industry standards is advantageous. 
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus. 
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks effectively, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines. 
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and adaptable to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment. 


What We Offer  


  • A pivotal role at the forefront of fintech innovation in a triple-A-rated country. 
  • A dynamic, supportive work environment that values forward-thinking and proactive engagement. 
  • Ample opportunities for personal and professional development in a mission-driven organization. 
  • Competitive compensation. 
  • A strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and social responsibility. 


How to Apply


Send your CV and cover letter in English to with the subject “Interface Designer / Web Developer ”. Short-listed candidates will be contacted within two weeks.

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.


Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Technical Project Manager  – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks
description:
We are seeking a Technical Project Manager – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks with strong expertise in mobile and converged network architectures to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Nokia network solutions, virtualization technologies, and key signaling protocols, and will play a crucial role in aligning network strategies with customer and business objectives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support mobile networks (2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G) and fixed/converged network architectures.
  • Manage and optimize virtualized environments using Nokia CBIS VMs , containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms such as NCS.
  • Work with Nokia network elements and third-party systems including CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, and CSD .
  • Troubleshoot and optimize signaling protocols such as SIP, Diameter, and S7 .
  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver network solutions aligned with customer and Nokia objectives.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and project risks effectively.
  • Provide deep analytical support and troubleshoot complex network issues.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of mobile network technologies (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), fixed and converged networks.
  • Experience with virtualization and container platforms (Nokia CBIS , Docker , Kubernetes , NCS ).
  • Familiarity with Nokia network components (CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, CSD ) and third-party solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SIP, Diameter, and S7 protocols.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with customers and internal stakeholders to meet technical and business goals.
  • Excellent risk management, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting aptitude.
  • Proficiency in English.

P

referred Qualifications

  • Certifications or relevant education in Telecommunications, Networking, or related fields.
  • Prior experience working with Nokia systems and large-scale network deployments.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Who We Are:


AdMaxTech is a leading mobile app user acquisition agency, working directly with top-tier advertisers across various app verticals. Our team brings together expertise from global tech giants and world-class performance marketing agencies.


Why Join Us:

  • Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely from your preferred location.
  • Be part of a fast-paced, results-driven environment in the booming mobile advertising industry.
  • The global mobile advertising market exceeded $280 billion in 2022 and is projected to reach $353 billion by 2025 — a 26% growth opportunity you can be part of.
  • Join a diverse, international team with a strong focus on collaboration, growth, and performance.


Your Role:

As a Business Development Manager, you will play a crucial role in expanding our advertiser partnerships and driving revenue growth. Your main responsibilities include:

✔ Research and identify the right decision-makers within potential advertiser organizations.

✔ Conduct pitch meetings and negotiations with prospective clients, aiming to close new deals.

✔ Collaborate closely with our internal teams to ensure a smooth onboarding process for new clients.

✔ Maintain up-to-date records and follow-up activities in our internal tracking system.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong research and communication skills.
  • Proven experience in business development, sales, or account management, preferably in digital marketing, mobile apps, or ad-tech.
  • Self-driven, organized, and result-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.


Why It’s Exciting:

The mobile app industry is growing fast — so are we. This is your opportunity to make a direct impact, contribute to our success, and grow your career alongside experienced professionals.


*AdMaxTech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
About the Role and Reponsabilities:

In this role you will have the chance to build large additions to our platform ecosystem, contributing to an infrastructure that centralizes our ETL and streaming infrastructure, enables experimentation and data development, and powers algorithm development. You will design and build scalable engineering solutions to solve business and data problems.


Core tech stack used by this role:

-S3 using Parquet and Iceberg for data storage

-Hive and Iceberg REST catalog as our metadata store

-Spark (Python, SQL, Scala) for data transformation

-Go, Scala and Java for backend development

-Kafka for data streaming

-Kubernetes and Helm for service deployments

-AWS IAM for access control

-Datadog for logging alerting and monitoring

-Trino as our federated query engine

-Identify, develop, and evangelize tooling, approaches, and data products that raise the bar of validity in experiment design and analyses across the company

-Collaborate with multiple teams and functions to deliver deep-dive analyses and experiment design for new initiatives and high-priority business areas

-Develop and iterate on our processes to empower more efficient and rigorous experimentation


Requirements

-You have a degree in an engineering or computer science field

-You have solid experience in platform engineering, with experience on experimentation platforms

-You have experience coding at a production level in Python, Go, Scala or Java

-You’ve built and supported RBAC systems used by enterprise-wide teams

-You have experience supporting Iceberg-based data warehouses

title: Brazil -Front-end Developer
description:
In Short

Arke is actively searching for a qualified Front-end developer in Brazil. You'll join our dynamic team, collaborating directly with our Brazil Country Head and fellow developers to create intuitive, appealing, and performant web applications for our clients. We’re looking for someone passionate about crafting outstanding user experiences and eager to stay current with evolving digital technologies.


Code samples are required.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with team members and clients to design and implement high-quality solutions based on technical and business requirements.
  • Use modern development standards and tools to create software applications that delight users.
  • Produce detailed documentation, test plans, and maintain well-documented, clean, and efficient code.
  • Foster trusted partnerships with coworkers and clients.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to explore innovative UI solutions.
  • Develop tested and documented TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Build responsive and cross-browser compatible applications optimized for desktop and mobile.
  • Adhere strictly to branding guidelines and UX standards.
  • Maintain positive and productive working relationships with stakeholders, peers, and management.


What We’d Love to See

  • 2–4 years of professional front-end development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.
  • Proven professional experience using React.
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and branch strategies.
  • Experience with browser compatibility testing and debugging
  • Strong understanding of UI design principles and layout aesthetics.
  • Basic knowledge of SEO best practices.
  • Intermediate spoken English, fluent in written English.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have excellent analytical and multitasking skills.
  • Be reliable and dependable, consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Next.js.
  • Familiarity with additional front-end frameworks.
  • Experience with content management systems (CMS).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or related fields.


Who We Are

Arke is a full-service experience design and technology consultancy that believes in providing more – much more. We change the way brands approach digital transformation and create defining moments to better connect brands with their customers. Arke’s core values are the soul of who we are and shape everything we do. We are authentically unique, operate with high standards, and love what we do.

title: JD Edwards Developer - English - Remote
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation, initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.


Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other client applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with client IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.


Required :

• Technical knowledge of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

description:
Estamos em busca de Tech Recruiter Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação North America da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por conduzir processos seletivos end2end e terá oportunidade de trabalhar com equipes multiculturais.


Você será responsável por:


  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento de tecnologia de ponta a ponta ;
  • Realizar hunting ativo e geração de pipeline qualificado para diferentes países da América do Norte;
  • Conduzir entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais de forma estruturada, garantindo aderência cultural e técnica;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com líderes e stakeholders, atuando de forma consultiva;
  • Alimentar e gerenciar informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter , garantindo a qualidade dos dados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e propor melhorias nos processos de recrutamento.


O que voce precisa ter:


  • Experiência prévia como Tech Recruiter em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Vivência com recrutamento internacional (US e Canada) e interação com times multiculturais;
  • Domínio de LinkedIn Recruiter e ferramentas de sourcing (boolean search, AI tools, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em perfis técnicos (Desenvolvedores, QA, DevOps, Data, Machine Learning, etc.);
  • Experiência com métricas de recrutamento (taxa de conversão, tempo de fechamento);
  • Inglês avançado para conversação;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa , em ambiente remoto e dinâmico.
  • Habilidades de negociação, comunicação e resiliência.




A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager to join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Develop partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);

  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;

Você será responsável por conduzir processos seletivos end2end e terá oportunidade de trabalhar com equipes multiculturais.


Você será responsável por:


  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento de tecnologia de ponta a ponta ;
  • Realizar hunting ativo e geração de pipeline qualificado para diferentes países da América Latina;
  • Conduzir entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais de forma estruturada, garantindo aderência cultural e técnica;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com líderes e stakeholders, atuando de forma consultiva;
  • Alimentar e gerenciar informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter , garantindo a qualidade dos dados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e propor melhorias nos processos de recrutamento;
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da marca empregadora na região LATAM .


O que voce precisa ter:


  • Experiência prévia como Tech Recruiter em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Vivência com recrutamento internacional (LATAM) e interação com times multiculturais;
  • Domínio de LinkedIn Recruiter e ferramentas de sourcing (boolean search, AI tools, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em perfis técnicos (Desenvolvedores, QA, DevOps, Data, Machine Learning, etc.);
  • Experiência com métricas de recrutamento (taxa de conversão, tempo de fechamento);
  • Inglês avançado para conversação;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa , em ambiente remoto e dinâmico.
  • Habilidades de negociação, comunicação e resiliência.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.
